reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets: I already count capsules into a pill case before trips, so one pocket-sized sachet a day saves me that, and 200 mg bisglycinate with no oxide is what my doctor meant. I would try one box, not a subscription, because there are no reviews yet.
objection: Two capsules a day, and if they are size 00 they are big and hard to swallow. The brand also has zero reviews, so I would be the guinea pig.
